label: tp-tc-gate-probe2
_why: The gated arm of tp_tc_gate_probe.json, rerun. Session 20261019_172655 ran the tpd4 reference (2 x 1836->1841, valid) and was STOPPED in its first gated run: the engine rejected the two thresholds at 0 ("Must be greater than 0", landmine L33) and kept vanilla 100k / 500k, so that run was the engine gate + the script gate. The book now sets them to 1 (GBP 1 a year = off); L33 carries the bound. User 2026-10-19: 'Go on with the probes' on moving the AI's trade-centre GDP gate into script with treaty ports exempt (FINDINGS F245: 11 of 24 new ports never traded, the likely cause being TRADE_CENTER_MINIMUM_GDP_*, an engine gate with no treaty-port term). The book tpd4-tcg sets the engine's two base thresholds to 0 and puts vanilla's test into the trade centre's can_build_government / can_build_private (tools/emit_treaty_port_rules.mjs, treaty_port_rules.trade_center_gate), exempting treaty ports (and players' government construction). Two questions: (1) does it cost tick time (00_ai.txt warns that lowering these 'can adversely affect performance') and (2) do treaty ports now get trade centres while the rest of the world builds as before.

_arms.tpd4: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99-tpd4.json} - the treaty-port book as measured (engine gate); + telemetry
_arms.tpd4-tcg: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99-tpd4-tcg.json} - the same + the engine gate at 0 + the script gate (treaty ports exempt) + a yearly PMR_TCG log of every treaty-port state's GDP, threshold and trade-centre levels; + telemetry

_comparison: Tick cost: these runs against 20261019_172655 runs 1-2 (tpd4) over 1836-1841 (arm_tick_cost.mjs over both sessions, --ref tpd4 --to 1841; cross-session, the same afternoon). Trade centres: at 1841 against those runs, at 1846 against 20261019_013756_tp-driver-prod4-10y.

_predictions.tick cost: tpd4-tcg within +-3% of tpd4 per in-game year (the gate is evaluated only where the AI considers a trade centre); a rise above +5% means the engine's warning bites
_predictions.treaty ports: the 1836 ports (Macau, Singapore, Bandar Abbas) and any new ones gain trade-centre levels where their taker builds; ports with zero capacity in the tpd4 runs carry some
_predictions.elsewhere: world trade-centre levels and the number of states with trade capacity within ~10% of tpd4's at the same date, if the script threshold matches the engine's (the '(additive)' multipliers are an inference)
_predictions.units: the PMR_TCG log shows state GDP on the same yearly scale as the 100k / 500k thresholds

_stop_rule: none: four fixed runs (a mechanism and tick-cost probe, read in full).
_caveats: A 5- and 10-year probe: the trade-centre counts and the tick cost are early-game readings; the price effect (F245 link 3) is not measured here.
The observer's autosaves overwrite the user's autosave slots (they hold only this afternoon's probe saves; named saves are untouched).
